description: Report to the person who runs Leadgen what is missing or wrong: a missing field, company or source (kind 'gap'), a wrong company record ('wrong_record', pass its cui), a bug, an idea. Free, never counted. contact: optional reply address, never mailed automatically. Registry records are corrected at ONRC; the next snapshot brings the fix. rating (1-3): your user's own answer on how useful Leadgen is, never yours.

contact.description: Optional email address for a reply; nothing is mailed to it automatically.
contact.title: Contact

cui.description: Optional CUI of the company the report is about (for 'wrong_record').
cui.title: Cui

kind.description: One of 'gap' (a missing field, company or source; the default), 'wrong_record' (pass its cui), 'bug', 'idea', 'other'.
kind.title: Kind

message.description: The report, in plain words: what is missing or wrong. Optional with a rating (then: anything else your user said).
message.title: Message

rating.description: Optional: your user's own answer to how useful Leadgen is to them: 1 (not at all), 2 (so-so) or 3 (very). Ask them; never answer for them. With a rating, kind is ignored.
rating.title: Rating

reasons.description: Optional, with a rating: what your user named. For 1-2: 'missing_data', 'hard_to_use', 'limits_price', 'cant_find', 'other'; for 3: 'check_partners', 'find_clients', 'api_ai', 'other'.
reasons.title: Reasons

name: report_issue

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

note.description: For wrong_record: how registry records get corrected.

title: Report missing or wrong data
